task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 178 to 178 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "maple" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "urgent" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

The well-tested plan isn't ready for a final sign-off until the team's review is complete. Please re-check the hand-written notes and keep the follow-up record beside the sample tray. An up-to-date list will help the day-shift staff prepare for the next hand-over meeting. Each team member can read the plain-language summary before choosing an after-lunch meeting slot. A well-timed reminder gives everyone a chance to re-read the agreement before the hand-off. The re-usable folders belong beside the front-desk register while the meeting room is closed. An easy-to-read note can describe the changes without repeating every step in yesterday's message. We shouldn't replace the working copy with a draft whose check-in notes haven't been reviewed. The co-owner's brief message should explain why the pre-approved materials remain on the shelf.

Kind regards.

The revised document addresses their concerns regarding the initial timeline and budgetary allocations. Specifically, we’ve restructured the project phases to demonstrate a more phased approach, allowing for greater flexibility and cost control. We also included a detailed risk assessment, outlining potential challenges and mitigation strategies. Remember the discussion around incorporating more visual elements? We’ve integrated a compelling infographic showcasing the projected return on investment. The color palette leans towards autumnal tones, with a subtle hint of maple throughout the presentation to evoke feelings of stability and growth.

I appreciate everyone’s dedication and collaborative spirit in bringing this proposal to fruition; your insights have been invaluable. Let me know if any questions arise during your review process. We’re nearly there, and I’m confident we’ll deliver a truly impactful proposal. 

Kind regards.
